replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Sure, I can offer up my services. The map looks pretty good as well too :D

And as a note, get rid of the player data and extra level.dat folder. You need one level.dat file and that is the main one. Keep the region file.

And make sure to prune the map using MCEdit as well to significantly shorten the map's file size.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Um, the skeletons by the stands disappeared because I had peaceful. I'll set spawners to make them spawn with the specific gear they had. I'll assume that you don't wish for them to be tampered with by annoyed people so I will add a no enter and no build region on them.

There seems to also be a large amount of OP items. I'll reduce the amount of the center swords specifically since they are more powerful than the ones found at spawn yet more numerous.

Update: The starting armor offers little defense to diamond and iron armor people. I'll add a full set of leather armor to counter this.
